facts.statement: Free Realms characters Chatdy and Robgoblin were scheduled to meet attendees at SOE's Block Party 2009 character meet and greet.
facts.quote: Meet Firiona Vie from EQ, Antonia Bayle from EQII, and Chatdy and Robgoblin from Free Realms!

facts.statement: Block Party 2009 was held Saturday, July 25, 2009, from 5:00 pm to 9:00 pm at SOE Headquarters in San Diego.
facts.quote: Block Party is Saturday, July 25th, 2009, from 5:00 pm - 9:00 pm at the SOE Headquarters

facts.statement: SOE Podcast #68 featured pictures from the SOE Block Party 2009 event.
facts.quote: This week also features fun pics from the SOE Block Party

article_summaries.title: SOE Block Party!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post previewing SOE's Block Party 2009 event (Saturday, July 25, 2009, 5:00-9:00 pm at SOE Headquarters in San Diego). It is mainly about SOE's multi-game event, and only mentions Free Realms in passing: the Free Realms characters Chatdy and Robgoblin will appear at a character meet and greet. The post gives no Free Realms gameplay details.

article_summaries.title: SOE Podcast #68 - News and Block Party Pics
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer post announcing SOE Podcast #68, a general SOE podcast covering Free Realms along with EverQuest, EverQuest II and Vanguard. The only Free Realms-specific content named is an interview with Candace Ivy, the game's Brand Manager, plus Block Party 2009 pictures. It contains no gameplay, quest, item or price details.
